description: This file implements the StateHandler class for managing lifecycle states within a plugin framework. It includes methods for updating, creating, validating, and changing states, as well as initializing state transition mappings and state strings. The code interacts with application context, event handling, and state transition logic.

classes.name: StateHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for managing lifecycle state transitions, creation, validation, and updates within the plugin framework.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates the application context to a new lifecycle state if valid, handling state transition logic.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates a new state object based on the specified lifecycle state.

methods.name: isValidTransition
methods.description: Checks if a transition from start to target state is valid, considering the current path.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the state transition map and state string mappings.

methods.name: changeState
methods.description: Performs a state transition request, validating the transition path, updating states, and emitting events.
